what_this_is: Session 17 (D-94, D-95): how the precision rule's readings, as Joe adopted them on 2026-11-18, are applied to the records the rule's table leaves needing a reading. At Stop 2 (D-95) Joe accepted the Elk River resolution 'on the described feature identification', retained the site-tied Olathe certificate assignments, and ruled that the WAPA customer-list omissions do not resolve South Jordan or Palo Alto: 'completeness, relevant dates and site-level coverage are not established'. Every page a record rests on was opened by the session with a plain client on the date given, unless it says otherwise.

bi:616-0.site: State Farm (now DigiCo), 24400 W Valley Pkwy, Olathe
bi:616-0.conflicting_name: City of Kansas City - (KS); Evergy Kansas Central
bi:616-0.why: D-94 preserves the certificate-based assignments 'provided the certificates are tied to those sites'. The tie on file: the Kansas commission's certificate for Johnson County (docket 117,213-U, 14 December 1978) lists T-13-S, R-23-E, 'Secs. 9 thru 12' under Kansas City Power & Light; the federal land survey puts the parcel, tied by address and owner, in section 9. So the tie is by survey section. That a tie by section meets his proviso is the session's reading. Stated limitation, from the record: later amendments to the certificate were not seen.
bi:616-0.ruled_by: Joe, D-95: 'retain the site-tied Olathe certificate assignments'.

omaha.why: D-94: the eight records rely on the two measured layers (the Power Review Board's 'Service Area Boundaries' and the state's 'Power Districts 2020'), each of which returns OPPD alone at the parcel and at the four probes and holds the line test on the distance on file; the class on file for each is 'meets all six conditions: medium'. OPPD's own PDF map is corroboration, the supporting page of condition (e), and not a depiction relied on; no distance is on file for it and none is needed. No conflict in it is on file. Stated limitation: the Board's layer is a convenience copy of its certified maps, the hard copies governing, and the publisher states no accuracy.
